faq: Can you edit a site on Squarespace 7.0?
Yes, though 7.0 has fewer layout tools than 7.1. We tell you what is possible before starting, and if a request would be easier after an upgrade to 7.1, we explain the options.
Will visitors see my site changing?
No. We work in draft where Squarespace allows it, preview the result and publish only after you approve, so visitors never see half-finished changes.
Can you add something Squarespace cannot do?
Often with a small piece of custom CSS or an embed. For bigger needs, our custom code service is the better match, and we tell you which one fits before we start.
What if an edit goes wrong?
We note the starting state with screenshots. Any edit you dislike is adjusted within your included revisions or rolled back to how it was, so nothing is lost.
desc:
Squarespace design edits and layout fixes cover the changes that keep a live site tidy: new sections, rearranged blocks, banner swaps and mobile clean-ups. Ecom Swift LLC makes the edits in your own account, previews them, and publishes only after you approve.

## What are Squarespace design edits and layout fixes?

Squarespace design edits are changes to how an existing site looks and is arranged, without rebuilding it. Typical examples are moving a block in Fluid Engine, replacing a banner image, restyling buttons, fixing a heading that wraps awkwardly on a phone, or adding a gallery or pricing block. A layout fix corrects something that is out of place or broken.

These jobs are small individually, yet they decide whether a site feels cared for.

## Why small edits are worth doing properly

A site is usually edited in a hurry. A photo is dropped in at the wrong size, a new section copies a different font, and a button color drifts from the rest. Each change looks harmless, but together they make the brand seem inconsistent.

Mobile makes it worse. A layout that looks balanced on a wide screen can stack in the wrong order on a phone, push a button off the first screen or cut a word in half. Checking every edit on both sizes prevents those faults from reaching visitors.

## How design edits affect the way visitors respond

Visitors read layout before they read words. Clear spacing and a consistent hierarchy tell them where to look first. A pricing block set out in clean columns lets them compare options without effort. A fresh banner signals that the business is active, and a tidy footer shows contact details where people expect to find them.

When the design is steady, attention goes to your message and your offer instead of to rough edges.

## Edits we commonly make

- Rearranging sections and blocks inside the Fluid Engine grid.
- Replacing banners, headers and hero images at the right proportions.
- Fixing text that wraps badly or overlaps on phones.
- Restyling buttons, fonts and spacing through site styles.
- Building a gallery, pricing block or feature row.
- Updating the header, navigation and footer.
- Adding a new page that matches your existing style.
- Aligning colors and fonts so every page agrees.
- Rebuilding a mobile layout that stacks poorly.

## How we work

You send a list of what to change, with page links and screenshots if you have them. We work on your site, check each edit at desktop and mobile widths and share a preview before anything goes public.

The Basic package covers a few quick fixes. Standard allows a larger round of edits, one new section or gallery, header and footer changes and spacing fixes. Premium covers the biggest round, new pages in your style, rebuilt mobile layouts and tidied site styles, followed by a short list of what changed. Your older site version stays unchanged until you say publish.

## Do and avoid when requesting edits

**Do:**
- Group related changes into one list.
- Send final text and images, not drafts.
- Point to pages you like as examples.
- Open the preview link on a phone before you approve.

**Avoid:**
- Sending changes in many separate messages.
- Asking for a new look through small edits, which a redesign handles better.
- Using very large photos that slow the page.
- Approving a preview you have not checked on mobile.

## Who this is for

A restaurant owner who needs a menu section added before a busy season will find edits faster than a rebuild. A consultant with a new service wants a clean page in the same style. A shop owner whose sale banner is out of date needs it replaced within the day.

## What we need from you

Share your edit list, page links and any new text or images. We never need your password. Add us as a contributor with permission to edit pages, and tell us whether your site uses version 7.0 or 7.1, so we can plan the right approach.
